_about: Approved calibration frames for config/ve/design-lock.json since its caption zone moved inside every channel's safe area (11 Nov 2026). Rendered by the engine (ve-render.mjs) from Krish's 5 Nov take with that day's props, under the new tall geometry (no wordmark over content). Each frame lists the caption words on screen, the only words its caption zone may hold. tests/ve_composition_test.py calibrates on these; the October H and P frames stay as history.
